topic: Should a team put RouteKit-style routing in front of model providers, or call each provider API directly?
side_a: A routing gateway (RouteKit) is better than calling provider APIs directly.
side_b: Direct provider APIs are simpler and better than a gateway hop.
reason: B conceded that a single direct client misses cross-vendor fallback.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: A single direct client dies on a 429. RouteKit's models[] list tries the next vendor on 429 or 5xx, which is the whole point of a gateway.

turns.speaker: caesar
turns.text: A 2 – B 0. Latest: A. grounding=0.92. A grounded the 429 fallback claim in the brief.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: Direct SDKs skip the extra hop. I concede: a routing gateway handles 429/5xx fallbacks that a single direct client will miss.

turns.speaker: caesar
turns.text: A 2 – B 0. Latest: B. grounding=0.90. B conceded that a single direct client misses cross-vendor fallback.
